covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Friday, October 9, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Monday, October 12, 2026.
market_context_summary: The actionable earnings window is empty after qualification. The U.S. stock market is open Monday, October 12, despite the federal holiday. Equity and event risk remain dominated by Iran-war oil volatility, Brent above $100, and a U.S. 10-year Treasury yield near 5.24%.

top_setups.note: No evidence-qualified U.S.-listed reporters existed in the strict actionable window, so no top-three setups are reported.

methodology.independence_note: The shared-universe screen produced zero qualified tickers. Passes A, B, and C therefore each evaluated the same empty universe; no scores or conclusions were fabricated.
methodology.disparity_definition: A 0-100 measure of dispersion across the three independent direction-score and reversal-risk assessments; lower means tighter agreement. It is not applicable when no company is scored.
methodology.learned_lessons_update: No scoring-method change. The existing timing-confirmation and listing-status guardrails excluded stale and time-unconfirmed calendar entries.
